text:
ashley_support: Customer escalation — multiple 5xx/timeouts after staged launch. Started ~2026-03-17T10:15 PDT. Customers on us-west reporting 502/504. Sample req ids: req-9a3b, req-4f7c. Logs attached.

ben_oncall: On it. Which rollout/version?

ashley_support: Staged rollout v2026.3.4 -> 10% traffic. Spike correlates with config apply in us-west cluster.

luca_infra: I'm seeing a new ConfigMap 'routing-overrides' applied to ingress controllers in us-west-2. Possibly header rewrite/route tag leak.

maya_prod: Alerts: proxy pool 'proxy-p-uw2' 5xx rate up 18% over baseline. Backend model-serve pods show many 'upstream prematurely closed connection' but pods remain Ready.

sam_engineer: Repro steps locally: 
```bash
curl -v -H 'x-route: alpha' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# returns 502 with 'recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)'
```

ben_oncall: Temp mitigation: rolling back routing-overrides configmap in us-west. Starting rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: rollback/configmap routing-overrides -> previous 2026-03-15. Traffic shift: 10% -> 0% for staged banner. ETA ~90s.

ashley_support: Customer reports errors dropping to baseline after rollback :thumbsup:

luca_infra: We'll collect diffs and pod-level traces. Suspect ingress rewrite sent to non-existent upstream tag 'alpha' causing proxy to drop conns.

sam_engineer: I'll capture request/response traces for affected req ids and open a PR to add a canary guard to the config apply pipeline.

ben_oncall: Assigning postmortem to @luca_infra and @sam_engineer. Please include timeline, config diff, and steps to prevent accidental route-tag leaks.

luca_infra: Will post final RCA in #incidents with config diffs and suggested guardrails.
